checked.comment: Stochastic K-armed bandit with 1-subGaussian rewards. The regret definition is through means, so it is pseudo-regret. The threshold tau uses T and K, so listing T and K as known is justified; sigma = 1 is fixed by the model.
Gaussian N(mu_i,1) rewards, used by Theorem 4; gaussian_known_variance is correct.
Matches Theorem 1: O(sqrt(KT)+sum Delta_i) for rho in (1/2,1) and alpha>=4.
Theorem 2 states the limit as an equality, sum 2/(rho Delta_i). Recording it as a limsup upper bound with rho declared as a symbol is acceptable.
Minimax part of Theorem 3, with the iterated-log factor declared as a symbol and the time-varying rho tuning recorded.
Minimax part of Theorem 4 for MOTS-J with alpha>=2 and Gaussian rewards.

summary: The extraction matches the source. All four theorems are recorded with the correct expressions, tuning, settings and registry ids. Lemma 5 (Lower Bound) only gives a lower bound on one term of the proof's decomposition, not on regret, so leaving it out is correct; the cited results match the paper's statements.
